x: 28 Women's Southern League Division 1, Match 1. 400m: 1 S Bovill 56.4. LJ: 1 S Wellstead 6.04; 1 K Euridge 5.35.
Second and 5th places came our way in the 400m thanks to Susan Bovill, running a nifty 55.45, and Sarah Gailey. Gradually the team positions settled down with the Belles hovering in 6th or 7th spot.

In spite of the home club picking up points at will, we also scored well in the 400 flat thanks to Susan Bovill and Sarah Gailey. Sarah seems to think nothing of using the preceding 800m as a warm-up.

One of our highest points scorers of 2007 is Susan Bovill who has had a good season. She took care of the 200/400 and was scheduled for both relays but had to pull out of the 4x400m having limped across the line on last leg of the short relay.
